packages.name: Aurora
packages.description: Reference theme: soft rounded cards, airy spacing and a translucent navbar. It reuses the colours and logo of the active icon pack.
packages.author: DDO

packages.name: Meridian
packages.description: Editorial print-magazine look: warm paper background, serif headlines, hairline rules, drop caps and an ink-black frame. Accent colour, logo and icons come from the active icon pack.
packages.author: DDO

packages.name: Nexus
packages.description: Modern gaming-media look: near-black navy surfaces, rounded bento cards with hairline borders, eyebrow labels, a scrolling live ticker, a numbered top-5 list and an accent taken from your icon pack. Ships its own home page layout.
packages.author: DDO

packages.name: Overdrive
packages.description: Modern dark gaming theme: deep navy surfaces, a glowing accent taken from your icon pack, angled corners, a flowing gradient rail and subtle motion (staggered reveals, hover glow, shimmer buttons, reading progress bar). All animation respects reduced-motion.
packages.author: DDO
